summary: UI Reviewer found 3 pre-existing axe-core a11y errors on /start/ that aren't allowlisted in .cloverleaf/config/ui-review.json. CLV-28's RFC is net-new-only so start.astro can't be modified — extend axe.ignored instead to match the established consumer pattern (see commit 0a5b0be, which allowlisted pre-existing /guide/ contrast issues the same way).

findings.message: Pre-existing color-contrast violation on /start/ at .footnote. Target is in start.astro (out of CLV-28 scope per RFC's net-new-only constraint). Resolve by appending {"ruleId":"color-contrast","target":".footnote"} to axe.ignored in .cloverleaf/config/ui-review.json.

Pre-existing link-in-text-block violation on /start/ at a[href$="guide/#chapter-7"]. Target is in start.astro (out of CLV-28 scope). Resolve by appending {"ruleId":"link-in-text-block","target":"a[href$=\"guide/#chapter-7\"]"} to axe.ignored.

Pre-existing link-in-text-block violation on /start/ at the GitHub repository link with rel=noopener target=_blank. Target is in start.astro (out of CLV-28 scope). Resolve by appending {"ruleId":"link-in-text-block","target":"a[rel=\"noopener noreferrer\"][target=\"_blank\"][data-astro-cid-6vq2egjc=\"\"]"} to axe.ignored.

Visual diff: /faq/ @ mobile [chromium] — 6.77% pixels differ (informational, not gating). Likely font-rendering noise between implementer's chrome-devtools baseline capture and Playwright headless. Re-capturing /faq/ baselines using the same Playwright capture script would normalize this. faq.astro was not modified by CLV-28.
Visual diff: /faq/ @ tablet [chromium] — 5.19% pixels differ (informational). Same root cause as mobile.
Visual diff: /faq/ @ desktop [chromium] — 3.15% pixels differ (informational). Same root cause as mobile.
